goal: Train SC2 AI via PPO on coop PvE (Dead of Night) using python-sc2 as real-SC2 framework and SimulatorSession as fast training backend, reusing existing replay contracts and BC pretraining pipeline.
acceptance: CmreRLEnv exposes reset/step/action_mask with typed contracts matching existing ActionCommand and observation encoder
SimulatorBackend and PythonSc2Backend produce same observation shape; feature_schema_hash is stable
Action mask correctly filters illegal actions based on observation state
Reward function derives dense + terminal signals from mission context without hidden state
Offline unit tests pass with a fake backend (no SC2 executable or simulator dependency)
Real-SC2 completion is claimed only with launcher and GameLogs runtime evidence
